entries.source: Causative form একাই ‘make’ না ‘let’ ঠিক করে না। Authority, context, ইচ্ছা, 〜てもいい এবং কথোপকথনের পরিস্থিতি বলে বোঝায় বাধ্য করা নাকি অনুমতি। প্রথমে form ও particle শিখে, তারপর সম্পর্কের nuance পড়তে হবে।
entries.target: Ang causative form mismo ay hindi tumutukoy sa 'make' o 'let'. Ang authority, context, kagustuhan, 〜てもいい at sitwasyon ng usapan ang nagsasabi kung ito ay pagpilit o pahintulot. Matutunan muna ang form at particle, pagkatapos ay basahin ang nuance ng relasyon.
Gagawa ka ng causative form ng tatlong grupo

entries.source: Original intransitive action-এ direct object নেই: 子どもが行く। Causative-এ causer মা topic, actor শিশুকে を: 母は子どもを行かせる।
entries.target: Sa original intransitive action, walang direct object: 子どもが行く. Sa causative, ang causer na ina ang topic, ang actor na bata ay を: 母は子どもを行かせる.

entries.source: Movement/location particles থাকে: 子どもを公園で遊ばせます; 弟を日本へ行かせます।
entries.target: Nananatili ang movement/location particles: 子どもを公園で遊ばせます; 弟を日本へ行かせます.

entries.source: Modern Japanese-এ permission/actor agency জোর দিলে intransitive-এর actor に-ও পাওয়া যায়, বিশেষ করে 行かせてあげる। কিন্তু Minna/N4 basic transformation-এ Personを প্রথমে আয়ত্ত করুন; প্রশ্নের context দেখুন।
entries.target: Sa modernong Hapon, kung bibigyang-diin ang permission/actor agency, makikita rin ang actor na に ng intransitive, lalo na ang 行かせてあげる. Ngunit sa Minna/N4 basic transformation, masterin muna ang Personを; tingnan ang context ng tanong.
Pinatayo ng guro ang estudyante.
Pinayagan ng ina ang bata na maglaro sa labas.

entries.source: কোম্পানি আমাকে ওসাকা পাঠিয়েছে/যেতে বাধ্য করেছে।
entries.target: Ipinadala ako ng kompanya sa Osaka/pinilit akong pumunta.

entries.source: কাউকে একটি object-এর ওপর কাজ করানো/করতে দেওয়া
entries.target: Pagpapagawa/pagpapahintulot sa isang tao na gumawa sa isang object

entries.source: Original: 学生が作文を書く। Causative-এ actor 学生に, original object 作文を অপরিবর্তিত। Actor-কে を করলে একই clause-এ দুই を conflict হয়; তাই に।
entries.target: Original: 学生が作文を書く. Sa causative, ang actor ay 学生に, ang original object na 作文を ay hindi nagbabago. Kung gagawing を ang actor, magkakaroon ng conflict ang dalawang を sa parehong clause; kaya に.

entries.source: Make/let context: 母は子どもに野菜を食べさせました—মা সবজি খাইয়েছেন/খেতে বাধ্য করেছেন। 医者は患者を休ませました—ডাক্তার রোগীকে বিশ্রাম নিতে দিয়েছেন।
entries.target: Make/let context: 母は子どもに野菜を食べさせました—pinakain/pinilit ng ina ang bata na kumain ng gulay. 医者は患者を休ませました—pinayagan ng doktor ang pasyente na magpahinga.

entries.source: Permission স্পষ্ট করতে 好きな本を読ませてあげました; compulsion স্পষ্ট করতে 無理に, 命令して ইত্যাদি যোগ করা যায়।
entries.target: Para linawin ang permission, 好きな本を読ませてあげました; para linawin ang compulsion, maaaring idagdag ang 無理に, 命令して at iba pa.
Pinagsulat ng guro ang mga estudyante ng kanji.

entries.source: মা ছোট ভাইকে ঘর পরিষ্কার করিয়েছেন।
entries.target: Pinalinis ng ina ang nakababatang kapatid ng kuwarto.

entries.target: Pinagawa ako ng department head ng ulat/sinabi sa akin na gumawa nito.

entries.source: Original object 作文を থাকায় actor に।
entries.target: Dahil may original object na 作文を, ang actor ay に.

entries.source: একই causative form বাধ্য করা বা অনুমতি—দুই অর্থ নিতে পারে
entries.target: Ang parehong causative form ay maaaring kumuha ng dalawang kahulugan: pagpilit o pahintulot

entries.source: Authority relation default inference দেয়। Boss→employee task প্রায়ই ‘করানো’; parent allowing child’s wish ‘করতে দেওয়া’।
entries.target: Ang authority relation ay nagbibigay ng default inference. Ang Boss→employee task ay madalas 'pagpapagawa'; ang parent na nagpapahintulot sa kagustuhan ng bata ay 'pagpapahintulot na gawin'.

entries.source: স্পষ্টতা চাইলে permission-এ Vさせてあげる/許す, compulsion-এ 無理に/命令する। শুধু বাংলা translation মুখস্থ করলে ambiguity হারাবেন।
entries.target: Kung gusto ng kalinawan, sa permission, Vさせてあげる/許す; sa compulsion, 無理に/命令する. Kung isasaulo mo lang ang Filipino translation, mawawala ang ambiguity.

entries.source: Causative নিজের benefit-এর permission request-এ させてください = আমাকে করতে দিন। আরও ভদ্র রূপ পরের pattern।
entries.target: Sa permission request para sa sariling benefit ng causative, させてください = payagan mo akong gawin ito. Ang mas magalang na anyo ay sa susunod na pattern.

entries.source: Causative = cause action; force/permission হলো context-level meaning।
entries.target: Ang causative = cause action; ang force/permission ay context-level meaning.

entries.source: শিশু যেতে চেয়েছিল, তাই একা যেতে দিয়েছি।
entries.target: Gusto ng bata na pumunta, kaya pinayagan ko siyang pumunta nang mag-isa.
Pinagsulat ng guro ang parehong pangungusap nang sampung beses.

entries.source: আজ আমাকে একটু আগে ফিরতে দিন।
entries.target: Payagan mo akong umuwi nang kaunti nang maaga ngayon.

entries.source: 帰ってください。（নিজের early-leave permission)
entries.target: 帰ってください. (sariling early-leave permission)

entries.source: 帰ってください অন্যকে ফিরতে বলে; নিজের permission = causative させてください।
entries.target: Ang 帰ってください ay nagsasabi sa iba na umuwi; ang sariling permission = causative na させてください.

entries.source: নিজেকে কাজটি করার অনুমতি/সুযোগ খুব ভদ্রভাবে চাওয়া
entries.target: Napakagalang na paghingi ng pahintulot/pagkakataon na gawin mismo ang gawain

entries.source: 使役て-form: 話させる→話させて; 帰らせる→帰らせて। তারপর いただけませんか—‘আমাকে করার অনুগ্রহটি গ্রহণ করতে দেবেন কি?’
entries.target: 使役て-form: 話させる→話させて; 帰らせる→帰らせて. Pagkatapos ay いただけませんか—'maaari mo bang payagan akong tanggapin ang pabor na gawin ito?'

entries.source: Business, interview, meeting, formal permission-এ বহুল: ここで自己紹介させていただきます (অনুমতি/সুযোগ পেয়ে পরিচয় দিচ্ছি)। অতিরিক্ত ব্যবহার bureaucratic শোনাতে পারে; সাধারণ permission-এ Vてもいいですか যথেষ্ট।
entries.target: Madalas ito sa business, interview, meeting, formal permission: ここで自己紹介させていただきます (nagpapakilala ako nang may pahintulot/pagkakataon). Ang labis na paggamit ay maaaring magtunog bureaucratic; sa karaniwang permission, sapat na ang Vてもいいですか.

entries.source: শ্রোতার অনুমতি/সুবিধা বাস্তবে relevant হওয়া উচিত। নিজের স্বাধীন কাজেও অকারণে させていただく over-keigo।
entries.target: Dapat na talagang relevant ang pahintulot/benepisyo ng tagapakinig. Kahit sa sariling malayang gawain, ang walang dahilan na させていただく ay over-keigo.

entries.source: Vていただけませんか অন্যকে করতে বলে; Vさせていただけませんか নিজেকে করতে দেওয়ার অনুমতি চায়।
entries.target: Ang Vていただけませんか ay nagsasabi sa iba na gawin ito; ang Vさせていただけませんか ay humihingi ng pahintulot na payagan akong gawin ito mismo.

entries.source: Causative form action ঘটায়; ‘force’ না ‘allow’ context ঠিক করে। Intransitive actor を, transitive actor に＋object を; নিজের formal permission-এ Vさせていただけませんか।
entries.target: Ang causative form ay nagpapangyari ng action; ang context ang tumutukoy kung 'force' o 'allow'. Ang intransitive actor ay を, ang transitive actor ay に＋object を; sa sariling formal permission, Vさせていただけませんか.
